result.summary: Found 1 major layout issue where the system home indicator overlaps with the bottom navigation bar icons.

issues.description: The system home indicator bar at the bottom of the screen overlaps directly with the middle icons (search and orders) in the bottom navigation bar.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom safe-area inset padding (`env(safe-area-inset-bottom)`) to the bottom navigation bar so the icons sit cleanly above the system home indicator.
